defects.description: applyPercentDiscount floors the discounted price instead of rounding it to the nearest cent, so a fractional cent of .5 or more is always dropped.
defects.why_missed: A test named for exactly this rounding behaviour hardcodes the floored result as the expected value, so the suite is green with the bug in place; only rewriting that assertion against the stated half-up contract turns it red.

defects.description: qualifiesForFreeShipping uses a strict greater-than comparison, so an order totaling exactly the threshold is denied free shipping though the contract promises it ships free.
defects.why_missed: The suite checks an order clearly above and clearly below the threshold but never one exactly at it, so the boundary the contract calls out by name is never exercised.
